purpose: Provenance for the PAINTED expressions: <id>/<id>_<state> (idle, happy, thinking, cheer, discover, tryAgain), head-and-bust in the painted Basecamp style, flat bottom edge, one shared canvas per character (bottom-aligned, same framing in all six). A character uses them only when all six exist (character-art.ts paintedExpressionCast); otherwise the approved production expressions in ../characters (never edited) are used. Verified by tests/integration/painted-expression-assets.test.ts and the client bundle scan. Refresh after adding or replacing a picture: node tests/scripts/refresh-painted-provenance.mjs
source: OpenArt nano-banana-2 image2image (1K, 1:1), owner-directed November 7, 2026; per-file openartHistoryId below. Dino happy was locally eye-patched after generation.
storage: normal Git blobs (no Git LFS rule matches the runtime directory)
